dataset_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu Tourist Places
name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

places.name: Diu Fort
places.description: A massive coastal fort built by the Portuguese, offering sea views, historic walls, bastions and lighthouse surroundings.

places.name: Naida Caves
places.description: A network of naturally lit rock formations and caves near Diu Fort, known for dramatic arches, passages and photography.

places.name: St. Paul’s Church
places.description: A prominent Portuguese-era church dedicated to Saint Paul, noted for its ornate façade and historic religious architecture.

places.name: Dudhni Lake
places.description: A scenic reservoir surrounded by forested hills, popular for boating, peaceful views and nature-based activities.

places.name: Silvassa Tribal Museum
places.description: A cultural museum displaying tribal traditions, tools, costumes, ornaments and objects representing the region’s indigenous communities.

visitor_notes: Check current opening hours, entry fees, boating availability and local travel conditions before visiting.
